bio: Hello everyone, my name is Yash Kshirsagar and I'm a passionate about Data Analyst and Frontend Developer with a specialization in building modern web applications. I love working with React, Node.js, and exploring creative possibilities with THREE.js and GSAP.

Driven by curiosity and a desire for excellence, I constantly strive to learn new technologies and improve my craft. My goal is to create web experiences that are not only functional but also visually captivating and user-friendly.

I have experience in a wide range of technologies including JavaScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and various backend tools. I'm always excited to take on new challenges and contribute to innovative projects.
